content.text: {"core": "Nurturing feeds what is trying to grow — steady tending, the small daily supply that keeps a thing alive. In Compassion, it works on the first pull toward another, the moment one turns and starts to care. Starved here, the turning-toward gets no feeding: warmth is felt but never handed over, and the tender start dries before it takes.", "sheetLine": "The caring is real; nothing was fed to the thing just beginning."}
